# System Design In Depth

> Open-source interactive platform for learning system design, storage engines, and distributed systems engineering from first principles.

- Canonical URL: https://system-design-in-depth.vedgupta.in/
- Repository: https://github.com/innovatorved/system-design-in-depth
- License: MIT (Code, Simulators & Labs) and CC BY 4.0 (Curriculum Content)
- Embedded Browser IDE: @innovatorved/code-lab v0.7.0 (https://code-lab.vedgupta.in/)

## Key Routes

- [Home & Capacity Envelope Workbench](https://system-design-in-depth.vedgupta.in/): Overview, interactive QPS/RAM/shard calculator, live simulator demos, and 6-track curriculum index.
- [Visual Prerequisite Roadmap](https://system-design-in-depth.vedgupta.in/roadmap/): 34-node dependency DAG, 5 role career paths, and 18 module explorers.
- [Production Incident Challenges](https://system-design-in-depth.vedgupta.in/challenges/): 12 interactive SEV-1 outage simulations with live parameter tuning and CodeLab hotfixes.
- [Architecture Whiteboard & Capacity Sandbox](https://system-design-in-depth.vedgupta.in/sandbox/): 10 system blueprints, topology canvas, QPS/bandwidth estimator, and rubric audit.
- [Learner Study Hub & Capacity Toolkit](https://system-design-in-depth.vedgupta.in/dashboard/): Progress analytics, SM-2 spaced-repetition flashcards, local notes, and 1ns=1s latency explorer.
- [System Design Glossary](https://system-design-in-depth.vedgupta.in/glossary/): Definitions across consensus, storage, networking, caching, and operations.
- [From-Scratch Build Labs](https://system-design-in-depth.vedgupta.in/build/load-balancer-from-scratch/): 20 multi-step coding labs running Node.js, Bun, and C++20 WebAssembly in the browser.

## Companion Open-Source Curricula

- [SQL In Depth](https://sql-in-depth.vedgupta.in/): Relational query execution, PostgreSQL 18 + SQLite 3 browser studio, and storage internals.
- [DSA In Depth](https://dsa-in-depth.vedgupta.in/): Data structures, step-by-step algorithm visualizers, and multi-language coding labs.
